result.note: Tested India's diplomatic response and the UAE's attribution, plus the strait where the July 2026 tanker attacks took place. Casualty counts and vessel names were skipped as not durable.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, Indian seafarers were killed and injured in missile attacks on two tankers. Consider the following statements about the incident:
items: The Ministry of External Affairs lodged a strong protest with Iran's Deputy Chief of Mission.
The UAE Defence Ministry attributed the strike to two Iranian cruise missiles.
The tankers were in Iranian territorial waters when they were struck.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the UAE said the missiles were fired while the tankers sat in Omani waters, not Iranian waters. India protested to Iran's envoy but condemned the attacks without publicly naming Iran, leaving the attribution to the UAE.
questions.source: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) Defence Ministry attributed the strike to two Iranian cruise missiles fired while the tankers sat in Omani waters.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India summoned Iran's deputy ambassador after missile attacks on two tankers carrying Indian crew. Through which strait were the tankers passing?
questions.explain: The tankers MT Al Bahiyah and MT Mombasa were struck while crossing the Strait of Hormuz, killing one Indian seafarer and injuring ten. The attacks followed fresh US action against Iran and a renewed threat to blockade the strait.
questions.source: India summoned Iran's deputy ambassador yesterday after an Indian seafarer was killed and ten injured in missile attacks on two tankers crossing the Strait of Hormuz.
